description: Examinations dated on either end date are counted together with those dated in between.

c.request: For examinations held between 1995-11-09 and 1997-03-17 (comparing the `Examination Date` as text), what is the average `ANA` value (ignoring missing values) and how many examination records are there in total? Give one row with the unrounded average first and the record count second. Examinations dated on either end date are counted together with those dated in between.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA), COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` >= '1995-11-09' AND `Examination Date` <= '1997-03-17'

a.request: Looking at examinations with an `Examination Date` on or after 1995-11-09 and on or before 1997-03-17 (comparing the dates as text), what is the average `ANA` value (ignoring missing values) and how many examination records are there in total? Give the answer as a single row with the unrounded average first and the record count second.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA) as average_ana, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` >= '1995-11-09' AND `Examination Date` <= '1997-03-17'

d.request: Return one row with the average ANA value (excluding null values) and the total count of examination records where Examination Date is between 1995-11-09 and 1997-03-17 inclusive.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA) as average_ana, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17'

b.request: Return the unrounded average ANA value (excluding missing values) and the total count of examination records where Examination Date is between 1995-11-09 and 1997-03-17 inclusive.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA) as average_ANA, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17'
b.raw: Return the unrounded average ANA value (excluding missing values) and the total count of examination records where Examination Date is between 1995-11-09 and 1997-03-17 inclusive.
